documents.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
documents.description: Common Paper Mutual NDA standard terms for protecting confidential information exchanged between two parties.

fields.label: Purpose
fields.default: Evaluating whether to enter into a business relationship with the other party.
fields.description: How Confidential Information may be used. It starts with a generic default; when the user says why they are sharing information, replace it with a short sentence describing that (e.g. "Exploring a joint product development project between the parties.")

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: When the MNDA starts

fields.label: MNDA Term
fields.description: Whether the MNDA expires a number of years after the Effective Date or continues until terminated

fields.label: MNDA term in years
fields.description: Whole number of years, 1 to 99, when the MNDA term expires

fields.label: Term of Confidentiality
fields.description: Whether information stays confidential for a number of years after the Effective Date or in perpetuity

fields.label: Term of confidentiality in years
fields.description: Whole number of years, 1 to 99, that information stays confidential

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.description: US state whose laws govern the MNDA, e.g. Delaware

fields.label: Jurisdiction
fields.placeholder: [Fill in city or county and state]
fields.description: City or county and state where disputes are heard, e.g. New Castle, DE

fields.label: MNDA Modifications
fields.description: Any changes to the standard terms; empty for none

documents.name: Cloud Service Agreement
documents.description: Common Paper standard agreement for selling and buying cloud software and SaaS products.

fields.label: Cloud Service
fields.description: The cloud service or SaaS product being sold, in a sentence or two

fields.label: Order Date
fields.description: The date of this Order Form

fields.label: Subscription Period
fields.description: How long the subscription lasts, e.g. "1 year from the Order Date"

fields.label: Fees
fields.description: What the Customer pays and when, e.g. "$1,000 per month, billed annually in advance"

fields.label: Non-Renewal Notice Date
fields.description: How long before the end of a Subscription Period a party must give notice not to renew, e.g. "30 days"

fields.label: Technical Support
fields.description: The support the Provider gives, e.g. "Email support on business days"

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: When the agreement starts

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.description: The state or country whose laws govern the agreement, e.g. Delaware

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.description: The courts that hear disputes, e.g. "the state or federal courts in New Castle, DE"

fields.label: General Cap Amount
fields.description: The cap on each party's liability, e.g. "the fees paid in the 12 months before the claim"

fields.label: Provider Covered Claims
fields.description: Third-party claims the Provider defends the Customer against, e.g. claims that the Cloud Service infringes intellectual property

fields.label: Customer Covered Claims
fields.description: Third-party claims the Customer defends the Provider against, e.g. claims arising from Customer Content

fields.label: DPA
fields.description: The data processing agreement that applies, if any

documents.name: Service Level Agreement
documents.description: Common Paper standard Service Level Agreement defining uptime targets, support response times and service credits for a cloud service.

fields.label: Subscription Period
fields.description: The subscription the SLA applies to, e.g. "1 year"

fields.label: Target Uptime
fields.description: The uptime the Provider commits to, e.g. "99.9% per month"

fields.label: Uptime Credit
fields.description: The service credit when Target Uptime is missed, e.g. "10% of the monthly fees"

fields.label: Scheduled Downtime
fields.description: Planned maintenance that doesn't count against uptime, e.g. "Sundays 2-4am UTC with 48 hours' notice"

fields.label: Target Response Time
fields.description: How quickly the Provider responds to support requests, e.g. "4 business hours"

fields.label: Response Time Credit
fields.description: The service credit when Target Response Time is missed

fields.label: Support Channel
fields.description: How the Customer contacts support, e.g. "support@provider.com"

documents.name: AI Addendum
documents.description: Common Paper standard addendum governing a provider's AI services, covering input, output, usage restrictions and model training.

fields.label: Agreement
fields.description: The existing agreement this addendum supplements, e.g. "Cloud Service Agreement dated March 1, 2026"

fields.label: Training Data
fields.description: The Customer data the Provider may use to train models; empty means no training is allowed

fields.label: Training Purposes
fields.description: What the Provider may train models for; empty means no training is allowed

fields.label: Training Restrictions
fields.description: Limits on training, e.g. "De-identify all data before training"

fields.label: Improvement Restrictions
fields.description: Limits on using Input and Output to improve the AI services without training

documents.name: Data Processing Agreement
documents.description: Common Paper standard Data Processing Agreement governing the processing of personal data under privacy laws such as the GDPR.

fields.label: Agreement
fields.description: The agreement under which the Provider processes personal data, e.g. "Cloud Service Agreement dated March 1, 2026"

fields.label: Nature and Purpose of Processing
fields.description: What the Provider does with the personal data and why

fields.label: Duration of Processing
fields.description: How long processing lasts, e.g. "For the term of the Agreement"

fields.label: Categories of Personal Data
fields.description: The kinds of personal data processed, e.g. names, email addresses

fields.label: Categories of Data Subjects
fields.description: Whose personal data it is, e.g. the Customer's employees and end users

fields.label: Special Category Data
fields.description: Any sensitive personal data processed, e.g. health data; empty for none

fields.label: Special Category Data Restrictions or Safeguards
fields.description: Extra protections for Special Category Data

fields.label: Frequency of Transfer
fields.description: How often data is transferred, e.g. "Continuous"

fields.label: Approved Subprocessors
fields.description: Subprocessors the Customer approves, or where the list is published

fields.label: Governing Member State
fields.description: The EU member state whose law governs the Standard Contractual Clauses, e.g. Ireland

fields.label: Security Policy
fields.description: The Provider's security policy, e.g. a URL

fields.label: Provider Security Contact
fields.description: Who to contact about security incidents, e.g. security@provider.com

documents.name: Business Associate Agreement
documents.description: Common Paper standard Business Associate Agreement setting out HIPAA obligations for handling protected health information (PHI).

fields.label: Agreement
fields.description: The services agreement under which the Provider handles PHI, e.g. "Cloud Service Agreement dated March 1, 2026"

fields.label: BAA Effective Date
fields.description: When the BAA starts

fields.label: Breach Notification Period
fields.description: How soon the Provider must report a breach, e.g. "5 business days"

fields.label: Limitations
fields.description: Limits on offshoring, de-identifying or aggregating PHI; empty for none

documents.name: Design Partner Agreement
documents.description: Common Paper standard agreement giving a partner early access to a product in exchange for feedback during development.

fields.label: Product
fields.description: The product the Partner gets early access to

fields.label: Program
fields.description: What the design partner program involves, e.g. "Monthly feedback sessions and access to beta features"

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: When the agreement starts

fields.label: Term
fields.description: How long the agreement lasts, e.g. "6 months"

fields.label: Fees
fields.description: What the Partner pays, if anything; empty for none

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.description: The state or country whose laws govern the agreement, e.g. Delaware

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.description: The courts that hear disputes, e.g. "the state or federal courts in New Castle, DE"

documents.name: Partnership Agreement
documents.description: Common Paper standard agreement for business partnerships where each party performs agreed obligations, such as co-marketing or integration arrangements.

fields.label: Obligations
fields.description: What each party does under the partnership, e.g. co-marketing or building an integration

fields.label: Territory
fields.description: Where the partnership applies, e.g. "North America"

fields.label: End Date
fields.description: When the partnership ends, e.g. a date or "2 years after the Effective Date"

fields.label: Payment Process
fields.description: How payments are made, e.g. invoicing and payment terms

fields.label: Payment Schedule
fields.description: What is paid and when

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: When the agreement starts

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.description: The state or country whose laws govern the agreement, e.g. Delaware

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.description: The courts that hear disputes, e.g. "the state or federal courts in New Castle, DE"

fields.label: Brand Guidelines
fields.description: Rules for using each party's brand, e.g. a URL

fields.label: Additional Warranties
fields.description: Any extra promises either party makes

fields.label: General Cap Amount
fields.description: The cap on each party's liability, e.g. "$100,000"

fields.label: Increased Claims
fields.description: Claims subject to the higher Increased Cap Amount

fields.label: Increased Cap Amount
fields.description: The higher liability cap for Increased Claims

fields.label: Unlimited Claims
fields.description: Claims with no liability cap

fields.label: Company Covered Claims
fields.description: Third-party claims the Company defends the Partner against

fields.label: Partner Covered Claims
fields.description: Third-party claims the Partner defends the Company against

fields.label: DPA
fields.description: The data processing agreement that applies, if any

fields.label: Deliverables

fields.label: SOW Term
